create.name: Irma StarSpirit Turtle Woman
create.bio:
A medicine woman and teacher in New York City, Irma StarSpirit Turtle Woman works in the ways of her Maya and Taíno ancestors and of the curanderas in her own family. She has followed this path for close to three decades and has trained to master level in Karuna Reiki, in crystal healing, which she also teaches, and in the Toltec dreamweaving tradition; she has spent many years in a MedicineWay apprenticeship and belongs to the Society for Shamanic Practice.

With Reiki master Judith Grasshopper she runs Shamanic Fire Reiki in Queens, which holds workshops, ceremonies, circles and certification programmes for its community. Irma's own classes cover the Vogel crystal wand, shamanic journeying with power animals, drum work, dreamtime and the elemental forces she calls the poderíos, usually woven together with prayer, song and traditional ceremony. Most of her sessions and classes now happen online, with occasional in-person intensives in the New York area, and she also teaches in the Kripalu Online Studio.

courses.title: Kripalu Online Studio
courses.description: Kripalu's online subscription of live and recorded classes, where Irma is one of the featured teachers. Members get unlimited live classes and a large on-demand library covering yoga, meditation and other practices.
courses.price: $39 USD per month or $365 USD per year

courses.title: The Vogel Wand Technique: Online Intensive
courses.description: An afternoon class on Zoom for Reiki, crystal and shamanic practitioners. Irma covers the history of Marcel Vogel's crystal wand and how to charge, activate and use one when working with the chakras and the wider energy field.

courses.title: The Spirit Canoe: Voyage to the Soul Awakening
courses.description: An online evening ceremony in which Irma guides the group on a journey to meet the ancestors, working with fire, water, power animals and the elements. Participants are asked to dress in blue or white and to have a journal and a gift for the earth with them.

courses.title: Dragon Lore & Healing Arts of Alchemy
courses.description: An online evening class that links dragon myths from around the world with shamanic alchemy and the elements. It includes stories, shamanic journeying, breathwork and meditation, and people who keep crystal dragons are invited to bring them.

courses.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe Ceremony & Rose Blessing
courses.description: An online ceremony for the feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe, co-led with Stephanie Citlalli. It explores the symbols in her image and her place as Tonantzin, and closes with a rose blessing rooted in curanderismo; participants bring a bouquet of roses.
